articles.title: 'We as a family together are dealing with it': Daler Mehndi’s son Gurdeep thanks Mika Singh amid Uttarakhand performance controversy
articles.summary: Singer Gurdeep Mehndi has expressed gratitude to Mika Singh for supporting his father, Daler Mehndi, amid the controversy surrounding the veteran singer’s
articles.body: Singer Gurdeep Mehndi has expressed gratitude to Mika Singh for supporting his father, Daler Mehndi, amid the controversy surrounding the veteran singer’s recent performance in Uttarakhand. Gurdeep said his family was dealing with the situation together and thanked members of the entertainment industry for standing by them. His remarks come as several celebrities, including Kapil Sharma and Sudesh Lehri, have voiced their support for Daler.Gurdeep Mehndi opens up about family’s responseIn a video shared on his official social media account on Saturday, Gurdeep revealed that he was outside India when the controversy emerged. After returning, he asked his father about his well-being. Daler responded in his characteristic cheerful manner, assuring his son that he was doing well.According to Gurdeep, his father’s response was simply 'first class'. The expression later became a talking point after Daler used it during an event. Gurdeep acknowledged the pressure surrounding the situation and said the family was working through it together.Gurdeep thanks Mika Singh for standing by DalerGurdeep expressed appreciation for the support his father has received from the film industry. He specifically mentioned Mika Singh, whom he affectionately addressed as his uncle, while acknowledging those who had reached out during the controversy."Obviously, we are stressed, and we as a family together are dealing with it. Thank you to everyone for the support, to the film industry, including my chacha ji, Mika Singh," Gurdeep said. He also urged people to continue supporting the family as they navigate the ongoing situation. Gurdeep ended his message by invoking his father’s familiar expression. "Continue to shower your love on us in this manner. Please support us. Like Papa says, Rab Rakka," he added.Gurdeep provides an update on Daler Mehndi’s healthBefore sharing his latest message, Gurdeep had reassured people about his father’s health. While he avoided commenting extensively on the controversy, he offered a positive update during an interaction with IANS. "He is first class, fantastic, super hit, and best of luck," Gurdeep told the news agency.Kapil Sharma and Sudesh Lehri extend supportMika Singh is among the prominent entertainment personalities who have publicly supported Daler during the controversy. Comedian Kapil Sharma and actor-comedian Sudesh Lehri have also expressed solidarity with the singer.Mika Singh shared a video defending Daler and discussing the professional commitments artists undertake. He questioned claims about his brother’s physical condition and explained that performers sometimes honour prior commitments even when they are unwell."Have you ever seen a glass of alcohol in his hand, or seen alcohol flowing freely at his birthday parties? No, you have not. Jab aapne dekha hi nahi, toh aapne kaise keh diya unse khada nahi hua jaa raha. Hum artists kayin baar kisi ke kehne par haan kar dete hain 'yes we will do the show'. Even if we have a 104-degree fever, it doesn't matter. If I am sick, and I have a show day after tomorrow, and I have already committed, then even if the budget is big or small, I will do it. Inhone (Daler) bhi aisa hi kiya hoga."Mika suggested that Daler might have honoured his commitment despite facing difficulties.Mika Singh took to X on September 24 to share a photograph with Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Dhami, revealing that the latter had contacted him personally to address the controversy involving Daler Mehndi. Mika said he had asked the Chief Minister to urge Uttarakhand Minister Subodh Uniyal to issue a video message apologising to the veteran singer. Uniyal had reportedly embarrassed Daler on stage by accusing him of being 'drunk'.In his post, Mika spoke about his regard for Dhami and welcomed the Chief Minister's decision to reach out to him over the issue."I have immense respect for the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Uttarakhand, @pushkardhamiji. He personally called me regarding the matter involving Daler Bhai, and I truly appreciate his gesture."I know Dhami Saab very well. He is a humble, down-to-earth person, and I have great respect for him," wrote Mika Singh. The singer said his request to Dhami was aimed at resolving the dispute and restoring Daler's dignity. He urged the Chief Minister to ask Uniyal to clarify his remarks and apologise publicly. "My only humble request to him is to please ask Shri @SubodhUniyal1ji to make a simple video clarifying his statement and apologising to Daler Bhai for saying that he was drunk during the performance. "I believe misunderstandings can happen, but they can also be resolved gracefully. I hope this small gesture will help put the matter to rest and ensure that Daler Bhai's dignity and reputation are respected," Singh wrote.Mika concluded his message by expressing confidence in the Chief Minister's ability to handle the matter. "I have faith in Dhami Saab's understanding and leadership," he added. The development follows Dhami's recent statement expressing his desire to bring the controversy to a close.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Wherever I go, they call me Rajan mon': 'Toxic' actor Sudev Nair says Mammootty's ‘Bheeshma Parvam’ made him popular among malayalis
articles.summary: Actor Sudev Nair has credited filmmaker Amal Neerad’s ‘Bheeshma Parvam’ with expanding his popularity among Malayalam audiences.
articles.body: Actor Sudev Nair has credited filmmaker Amal Neerad’s ‘Bheeshma Parvam’ with expanding his popularity among Malayalam audiences. The actor, who played Rajan Mon in the Mammootty-starrer, said the character continues to be recognised by Malayalis wherever he goes. During an interview with Club FM, Sudev also explained why the film’s director has become someone many actors want to work with.‘Bheeshma Parvam’ gave Sudev Nair wider recognitionSudev Nair said his role as Rajan Mon helped him reach audiences beyond the urban circles familiar with his earlier work. He identified ‘Ezra’ and ‘Bheeshma Parvam’ as two important projects that shaped his identity among Malayalam filmgoers.“It's no wonder everyone wants to work with Amal Neerad. The character Rajan Mon in ‘Bheeshma Parvam’ earned me a lot of acceptance in Malayalam cinema. I have two or three identities in Malayalam. One is ‘Ezra’, and the other is Rajan Mon from ‘Bheeshma Parvam’. Wherever I go, if there are Malayalis around, they call me Rajan Mon. The reach of ‘Bheeshma Parvam’ is tremendous. Before that, I had an urban reach. Because of Mammootty’s reach, that changed. More people came to know me,” Sudev said.Actor says his performance was not differentSudev explained that he did not approach Rajan Mon with a dramatically different performance style. He said his work on ‘Bheeshma Parvam’ followed the same approach he had taken with his other films. However, he believed the director’s presentation and the film’s technical aspects helped the character connect with viewers.“As a performer, I haven't done anything particularly different. I worked on this film just as I have worked on all my other films. But when Amal Neerad’s presentation, framing, background music and the way I was positioned alongside Mammootty come together, the audience naturally develops a connection. That is a matter of luck,” Sudev said.‘Udumbanchola Vision’ receives attention in theatresSudev Nair is currently attracting attention for his role in ‘Udumbanchola Vision’. The film has reportedly been receiving a positive response from audiences in theatres. The film has Mathew Thomas in the lead role.Sudev Nair was also recently seen in ‘Toxic’, an action film starring Yash and directed by Geetu Mohandas.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'You always talk one-sidedly': Gajendra Chauhan slams Naseeruddin Shah over SRFTI protest remarks
articles.summary: Actor Gajendra Chauhan criticised veteran actor Naseeruddin Shah for his remarks about the ongoing student protest at the Satyajit Ray Film and Television
articles.body: Actor Gajendra Chauhan criticised veteran actor Naseeruddin Shah for his remarks about the ongoing student protest at the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute (SRFTI). Gajendra objected to Naseeruddin’s criticism of the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). He urged the veteran actor to offer constructive advice instead of attacking the government. Gajendra also emphasised that dialogue between students and the institute’s administration was necessary to resolve the dispute.Gajendra Chauhan reacts to Naseeruddin Shah’s remarksWhile speaking to IANS, Gajendra expressed disappointment over Naseeruddin’s description of the ruling party as a "bloody jhooti party". "It is a very sad thing. A party that has been ruling the country for the last 12-13 years, you called it a 'bloody jhooti party'. You should be ashamed. 140 crore people of the country have made that party sit at the top, and you are abusing it."Accuses Naseeruddin Shah of presenting one-sided viewsWhile acknowledging Naseeruddin’s standing as an artist, Gajendra said he believed the actor should consider different perspectives when discussing political matters. He claimed that Naseeruddin’s social media posts and videos frequently presented only one side of an issue."You are a great artist. You are a good human being. But I have always seen that in your tweets, in your videos, you always talk one-sidedly. You never look at both sides of the coin," he added.Urges dialogue to resolve SRFTI student protestTurning to the developments at SRFTI, Gajendra said the institute’s administration was capable of addressing the students’ concerns. He acknowledged their right to protest but argued that an indefinite agitation would not necessarily resolve the matter without discussions between the parties involved."If there is a strike in SRFTI, the administration there will look into it. There are capable people sitting there. It is a student's right to protest, but there is no result to protest unless you sit together and talk. You should advise the students, instead of criticizing the government there, which has worked so hard. Our workers, our politicians have worked so hard and won and have removed such people from power, who were not doing anything for people. The rest is up to you. You are a great artist. Just be a little positive," he shared.Naseeruddin Shah accuses the ruling party of targeting criticsGajendra’s comments came after Naseeruddin spoke out about the student agitation on Saturday, as reported by IANS. The veteran actor alleged that the ruling party was taking "revenge" on people who did not agree with its beliefs and policies. He described the students protesting at SRFTI as the latest group to face such treatment.Reportedly, the students at the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute are currently holding an indefinite sit-in demanding the resignation of their Vice-Chancellor. The protest follows a recent confrontation between students and members of the Akhil Bharatiya Grahak Panchayat (ABGP), a consumer awareness organisation affiliated with the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS).The agitation has drawn attention to the students’ demands and the institute’s response. Gajendra has maintained that the administration should be allowed to address the concerns through dialogue, while Naseeruddin has criticised what he sees as political retaliation against those who oppose the ruling party.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Clint Eastwood, 96 años, sobre la vejez: "Cada vez que alguien me dice que soy demasiado viejo para hacer algo, intento hacerlo de inmediato"
articles.standfirst: Aunque él no ha anunciado oficialmente su retiro, medios estadounidenses así lo dicen
articles.summary: Aunque él no ha anunciado oficialmente su retiro, medios estadounidenses así lo dicen
articles.body: En 2018, durante una charla entre Clint Eastwood y el cantante de música country Toby Keith, mientras jugaban al golf, el actor y director, de 96 años, habló sobre la vejez y el paso del tiempo, señalando que es algo contra lo que siempre se encuentra luchando. En un momento de la conversación, el legendario intérprete se refirió a todos aquellos que han cuestionado su capacidad debido a su avanzada edad, señalando: "Cada vez que alguien me dice que soy demasiado viejo para hacer algo, intento hacerlo de inmediato". Y es que, según explicó, la edad es algo bueno a lo que no hay que temer: "A medida que envejeces, tienes más experiencia, cuentas con más recursos...". Algo que tiene en la cabeza día a día: "Me levanto cada mañana y no dejo entrar al viejo". Nacido en San Francisco, California, el 31 de mayo de 1930, Clint Eastwood ha participado como actor en algunas de las cintas más famosas de la historia, como ‘El bueno, el feo y el malo’ o ‘Los puentes de Madison’. Pero como director también tiene una amplia trayectoria, participando en muchas de sus producciones, como ‘Million Dollar Baby’, ‘Million Dollar Baby’ o ‘Gran Torino’. La etapa final de la carrera de Eastwood ha sido una de las demostraciones de longevidad más asombrosas de la historia del cine. Estrenó ‘Mula’ en 2018, rodada a los 88 años, repitiendo a los 91 años con ‘Cry Macho’ (2021), protagonizando ambas. Sin embargo, su adiós definitivo llegó con ‘Jurado Nº 2’ (2024), un thriller judicial que hizo con 94 años, poniendo fin a su carrera, en principio, según varios medios estadounidenses, ya que nunca se sabe si podría volver en cualquier momento, porque en su última entrevista, para Metrograph, señaló: “Eso le corresponde al público responderlo (su retirada). A la gente de fuera. Yo simplemente me dejo llevar”.

articles.title: 'Dhurandhar' composer Shashwat Sachdev’s wife reveals he got piano and speakers in the bedroom: ‘This tune has become an excuse’
articles.summary: Shashwat Sachdev, the composer who rose to prominence with Aditya Dhar’s hit spy franchise 'Dhurandhar', was recently a guest on Kapil Sharma’s show with
articles.body: Shashwat Sachdev, the composer who rose to prominence with Aditya Dhar’s hit spy franchise 'Dhurandhar', was recently a guest on Kapil Sharma’s show with his family. On the episode, his wife Shruti Sachdev shared how his devotion to music often leads to funny exchanges at home.Shashwat Sachdev’s studio-versus-home debateRecalling their early days in Mumbai on 'The Great Indian Kapil Show', Shruti said: “When we moved to Mumbai, we were in a 1BHK, in which the H (hall) became a studio. So, only the bedroom was left. That’s why we were always in each other’s faces.” She went on to say that once they were more settled and bought a house, she made things clear to her husband: “After some progress, when we bought a house, I told him, ‘That studio is your space; the house is mine.’”Shashwat Sachdev wants piano at homeShashwat, however, countered that he would have to dash to the studio every time inspiration struck, and proposed keeping a piano at home too. Shruti agreed to place one in the living room, but he pushed further, asking, “What if I get a tune at night? What would I do then?” Shruti quipped, “This tune has just become an excuse now.”Shashwat Sachdev says his music is for wife ShrutiShe then relented and allowed a digital piano in the bedroom, on the condition that he would play it only with headphones. Shruti recalled, “The next day, when I came home, there were two speakers along with the piano in the bedroom as well,” leaving everyone in splits. Reacting to his wife’s revelations, Shashwat said she remains the inspiration behind most of his music. “All of my music is for her. If I get a little distracted, I also dedicate some music to God; otherwise, it’s all for her,” he said.Shashwat Sachdev’s musical trainingShashwat started out on the tabla when he was just three years old, and later trained in Hindustani classical vocals under Ustad Ramzan Khan. He also learned Western classical piano. Once he completed his studies, he relocated to Los Angeles in 2011 to build a career in music production.After moving back to India, Shashwat got his first break as a composer with Anshai Lal’s 2017 period romance 'Phillauri'. He went on to score four songs for Shashanka Ghosh’s 2018 buddy comedy 'Veere Di Wedding', and later won his first National Award for Best Music Direction for Aditya Dhar’s hit military drama 'Uri: The Surgical Strike'. articles.summary: Filmmaker Kunal Kohli has appealed to the Mumbai Police to investigate alleged drug-related activities at Carter Road's skateboard park in Bandra.
articles.body: Filmmaker Kunal Kohli has appealed to the Mumbai Police to investigate alleged drug-related activities at Carter Road's skateboard park in Bandra. The director raised concerns about a group reportedly using and selling drugs at the public space, which is frequented by children. He shared his concerns on social media and requested authorities to intervene.Kunal Kohli raises concerns over children's parkKunal Kohli alleged, tagging the Mumbai Police's official social media account, that the group's presence was creating problems at the skateboard park. He also claimed that some individuals were engaging in inappropriate activities in the public area. “This group of drug addicts & drug sellers are creating a mess. They sleep without clothes sometimes & are involved in all sorts of activities that I cannot say here on social media. I request you to please clear the children’s park of this gang.”Director frequently speaks out on social mediaKunal Kohli has used social media to raise issues he believes deserve public attention. His latest appeal concerns the alleged activities at the Bandra skateboard park and the need to maintain a suitable environment for children visiting the space. The director's post calls for intervention against the group he has described. However, details about the individuals involved and the status of any police investigation remain unavailable.Kunal Kohli's message to Tukaram MundheIn another recent social media post, Kunal Kohli addressed Tukaram Mundhe, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) commissioner, with a humorous suggestion about checking household kitchens and refrigerators for expired products.“I request Tukaram Munde to raid kitchen shelves & refrigerators in Indian households across the country. There will be expired items, from years ago, neatly and safely preserved, the bottles & packets wiped clean every month & put back on the shelf or refrigerator never to be used again.” The filmmaker also encouraged people to conduct what he called a ‘Tukaram Munde cleaning’ at home. His remark drew on the familiar habit of keeping old food products and packaged items in storage long after their expiry dates.Kunal Kohli has also commented on how celebrities are photographed in public. He previously praised Salman Khan after the actor criticised paparazzi for taking inappropriate pictures of actresses, including photographs focusing on their backsides. The filmmaker has spoken against body-shaming and remarks about people's age and physical appearance. Salman Khan also appeared to support his friend Katrina Kaif after she faced online comments about her weight and appearance.Kunal Kohli is known for directing Hindi films across genres, including the romantic comedy 'Hum Tum'. articles.title: Radhika Apte on violent films: 'I don't understand how one can watch and eat popcorn while 50 men or women are getting beaten up'
articles.summary: Radhika Apte, known for choosing varied roles across genres, has made it clear that she wants no part of the extremely violent films that are ruling
articles.body: Radhika Apte, known for choosing varied roles across genres, has made it clear that she wants no part of the extremely violent films that are ruling cinemas today. Speaking ahead of her series ‘Akka’, the actor also opened up about how motherhood has changed the way she looks at work.A career without typecastingIn a career of nearly two decades, Radhika Apte has tried her hand at almost every genre and has stayed clear of being typecast. However, she draws the line at films with excessive violence, especially the popular mass action kind.Radhika Apte’s view on screen violenceWhile promoting ‘Akka’, which revolves around the rivalry between two gangsters, Radhika Apte told PTI, "What is working right now is violence, and I’m vehemently against it. So, it’s a tricky situation.”She pointed out that violence-heavy films seem to be bringing in theatrical business, but she does not want to be part of that trend. She said, “I don’t watch those films; I find them absurd. Like, I don’t understand how one can watch and eat popcorn while 50 men or women are getting beaten up and creatively beaten up because last time he broke his skull on a sink, so this time let’s break it on some other slab. I can’t compute it. So, I’d rather not be a part of it.”Radhika Apte says, ‘Priorities have changed’The 41-year-old actor, who welcomed her daughter in 2024, shared that her work priorities are now different, and fixed working hours matter the most to her. She said, “All I ask for is 12 hours of workday and not a 16-hour workday or like some time off, and it’s not always possible. I also wanted to not work because nothing was worth (doing it). For me, I wanted to be with her as much as possible, and I still do because she’s too small. So, I think all those things and my work is not my life. It has never been my life; it’s part of my life. So, things are ever changing. Tomorrow I might stop doing everything, or I might do a lot. Who knows? So, it’s not like there’s one reason necessarily (for not doing films).”All about ‘Akka’Set in the 1980s, ‘Akka’ is a gangster drama that stars Keerthy Suresh and Radhika in the lead. It will stream on Netflix from October 30. Tanvi Azmi, Mahesh Manjrekar, Anshuman Pushkar and Monica Panwar play key roles.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Chivu: Why Provedel and Mkhitaryan ‘deserve to start’ in Inter vs. Fiorentina
articles.summary: Cristian Chivu explains why Ivan Provedel and Henrikh Mkhitaryan deserve to start in Inter’s home Serie A game against Fiorentina.The defending Serie A champ...
articles.body:
Cristian Chivu explains why Ivan Provedel and Henrikh Mkhitaryan deserve to start in Inter's home Serie A game against Fiorentina.

The defending Serie A champions host Fiorentina at San Siro in Sunday's Serie A lunchtime game.

Chivu explains his line-up choices for Inter vs. Fiorentina

BOLOGNA, ITALY – OCTOBER 17: Cristian Chivu, Manager of FC Internazionale Milano, looks on before the Serie A match between Bologna FC and FC Internazionale at Stadio Renato Dall'Ara on October 17, 2026 in Bologna, Italy. (Photo by Emmanuele Ciancaglini/Getty Images)

Inter's second-choice keeper Provedel makes his debut, replacing Josep Martinez, who had started every game so far.

"Provedel deserves to start after this week, when his child was also born, and for the work he's done these months, supporting Pepo too. From here to the end of the season, he'll help us rotate," Chivu told DAZN before kick-off.

"It's a hard game. Fiorentina are a well-trained team," added the Nerazzurri boss.

HONG KONG, CHINA – AUGUST 1: Matteo Lavelli of Inter Milan (R) celebrates after scoring his penalty kick goal with goalkeeper Ivan Provedel of Inter Milan (L) during a penalty shoot-out after the Manchester City v Inter Milan – Pre-Season Friendly at Kai Tak Stadium on August 1, 2026 in Hong Kong, China. (Photo by Yu Chun Christopher Wong/Eurasia Sport Images/Getty Images)

"Recently, they've earned less than they deserved. They have many things that can make you struggle; they do many things well. We can't choose; we must leave everything we have on the field."

Mkhitaryan gets the nod in central midfield for Inter today, joining Nicolò Barella and Hakan Calhanoglu.

Mkhitaryan was instrumental to Inter's 1-0 win over Shakhtar Donetsk in the Champions League on Wednesday, providing a brilliant assist with Carlos Augusto, while the Nerazzurri were down to ten men.

MILAN, ITALY – DECEMBER 03: Antoine Hainaut of Venezia FC is challenged by Henrikh Mkhitaryan of FC Internazionale Milano during the Coppa Italia round of 16 match between FC Internazionale and Venezia FC at San Siro Stadium on December 03, 2025 in Milan, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)

"I don't look at the ID, nor at who was born earlier or later," Chivu concluded.

"The last few times he was on the pitch, he added something we missed, and he deserves to start."

With Lazio beating Parma 2-1 on Saturday, Inter need a win today to catch the Bianconcelesti at the top of the table.
